objectives.text: Measure more accurately the costs of Federal credit programs.

citations.quote: (1) measure more accurately the costs of Federal credit programs;

objectives.text: Place the cost of credit programs on a budgetary basis equivalent to other Federal spending.

citations.quote: (2) place the cost of credit programs on a budgetary basis equivalent to other Federal spending;

objectives.text: Encourage the delivery of benefits in the form most appropriate to the needs of beneficiaries.

citations.quote: (3) encourage the delivery of benefits in the form most appropriate to the needs of beneficiaries; and

objectives.text: Improve the allocation of resources among credit programs and between credit and other spending programs.

citations.quote: (4) improve the allocation of resources among credit programs and between credit and other spending programs.

objectives.text: The stated overall purpose of the Credit Reform subchapter.

citations.quote: The purposes of this subchapter are to-
(1) measure more accurately the costs of Federal credit programs;
(4) improve the allocation of resources among credit programs and between credit and other spending programs.

notes: This item is a purposes-only section (2 U.S.C. 661) stating the four purposes of the Federal Credit Reform Act of 1990's Credit Reform subchapter. It contains no operative obligations (no actor/modality duties) — only aspirational statutory purposes, extracted here as objectives. It defines no terms itself; the credit-program terms it uses are undefined in this section. It functions as a cross-cutting budgetary framework for federal loan/guarantee programs, relevant to the scope's commercial lending subsidy/guarantee programs but does not itself administer any lending program.
